row.evidence: xMatters documents SCIM 2.0 provisioning from Okta and Microsoft Entra ID at https://hostname.xmatters.com/api/xm/1/scim/v2, but neither the pricing page nor the SCIM docs say which plan includes it.
row.notes: New row. Status unknown under rule 1a: SCIM is documented with no plan named, on a product with Free, Starter, Base and Advanced tiers. Pricing page lists Free ($0, up to 5 users), Starter/Essentials ($15 user/month, up to 25 users), Base/Standard ($39 user/month) and Advanced (contact us); billing period not stated, recorded as shown. Single Sign-On is marked on Starter and above, not Free; API Access is included on all tiers. SCIM supports users, groups, roles and an xMatters custom-attribute extension but not the enterprise extension; Okta deprovisioning deactivates rather than deletes. Bulk CSV User Upload and the EPIC data-sync client are alternative sync paths.

auth.token_source: Workflows > OAuth: run the OAuth token cURL command against /api/xm/1/scim/v2/tokens (Entra); Okta guide uses Basic auth with a SCIM user's username and password
auth.token_expiry: 1 year by default (not refreshable for Entra)

deprovision.data_retained: With Okta, deleting or unmapping the user deactivates the xMatters user rather than removing it.

custom.how: xMatters extension schema urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:xmatters:2.0:User:<property> (listed at /api/xm/1/scim/v2/Schemas), mapped as custom attributes in Entra; the Okta guide says the extension is still in development

roles.how: roles attribute (single primary role or multi-value via Entra app roles); values must match xMatters role names

limitations.text: The enterprise user extension (EnterpriseUser) is not supported; unsupported attributes return 400 Bad Request.
Okta does not send SCIM DELETE and cannot change usernames.
Entra SCIM tokens cannot be refreshed and must be recreated when they expire (one year by default).

scim.notes: No plan is named for SCIM on the pricing page or in the SCIM docs. Both IdP guides use generic SCIM apps (Okta 'SCIM 2.0 Test App (Basic Auth)', Entra non-gallery app); xMatters has no SCIM-enabled catalogue app.

endpoints.purpose: Create a person (or modify one when the body carries its id)
Add a member to a group
Remove a member from a group

audit_log_api.notes: GET /audits returns event audit records (annotations, responses), not an admin audit log.

rate_limits.text: Rate limited; exceeding the limit returns 429 Too many requests (no figure published).

okta.notes: OIN capabilities read from page markup: SAML only (last updated Sep. 11 2019). Provisioning is done through Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 Test App per xMatters' guide (c11).

entra.notes: Gallery app 'xMatters OnDemand' is SSO only; provisioning uses a non-gallery app with the generic SCIM endpoint (c17). No Entra provisioning tutorial exists.

fallbacks.other_sync: EPIC data sync client (file-based sync from a record source); User Upload CSV template
